the use of a plate-shaped active-element geometry in high-power pulse-periodic glass lasers is promising.

the use of a plate-shaped active-element laser with a high concentration of activator ions in the glass allows a high output power and efficiency to be achieved.
the maximum output power of a neodymium glass plate-shaped active element laser can be increased by a factor of 1.5–2 by using a high-concentration activator and an efficient illumination enclosure.
the use of a plate-shaped active medium is a promising approach in the construction of high-power neodymium-glass lasers.

the maximum output power can be increased to 300 W by using a plate of 15 × 30 × 0.5 cm dimensions, with an activator concentration of 0.2 wt %.
